mentions.heading: Adverse developments affecting one or more of our suppliers could harm our profitability.
mentions.detail: Sole-source suppliers may fail under commodity cost volatility or volume swings, causing delays or non-conforming products
mentions.quote: Any significant disruption in our supplier relationships, particularly relationships with sole-source suppliers, could harm our profitability. Some of our suppliers may not be able to handle commodity cost volatility and/or sharply changing volumes while still performing as we expect.

mentions.heading: Discontinuation or loss of business for a product where we are a significant supplier
mentions.detail: Purchase orders cover annual or life-of-model requirements, not fixed quantities; OEM customers may in-source components
mentions.quote: If our OEM customers successfully in-source products currently manufactured by us, the discontinuation or loss of business for products which we are a significant supplier could reduce our sales and harm our profitability.

mentions.heading: Increases in costs of the materials and other supplies that we use in our products may have a negative impact on our business.
mentions.detail: Copper, resin, semiconductors, fuel price swings; limited pass-through especially with U.S. OEMs; demand driven by China
mentions.quote: In recent periods there have been significant fluctuations in the global prices of copper, petroleum-based resin products, semiconductors and fuel charges, which have had and may continue to have an unfavorable impact on our business, results of operations or financial condition.

mentions.heading: Our hedging activities to address commodity price fluctuations may not be successful
mentions.detail: Hedges only near-term raw material exposure; no protection from long-term price increases
mentions.quote: Our hedging activities are not designed to mitigate long-term commodity price fluctuations and, therefore, will not protect from long-term commodity price increases.

mentions.heading: We may encounter manufacturing challenges.
mentions.detail: Customers do not commit to long-term production schedules, hampering capacity utilization
mentions.quote: Due in part to these factors, many of our customers do not commit to long-term production schedules. Our inability to forecast the level of customer orders with certainty makes it difficult to schedule production and maximize utilization of manufacturing capacity.

mentions.heading: We may encounter manufacturing challenges.
mentions.detail: Relies on third-party suppliers and contract manufacturers for components, assemblies and finished products
mentions.quote: We rely on third-party suppliers for components used in our products, and we rely on third-party manufacturers to manufacture certain of our assemblies and finished products.
